routes.label: Find profit and add it to cost

question: An item has a cost price of 80 yuan and a profit rate of 25%. What is its selling price? (Unit: yuan)
solution: Profit = cost price × profit rate = \(80\times25\%=20\) yuan. Selling price = cost price + profit = 100 yuan.
